purpose: A source-agnostic robotics evidence corpus. Video is one observed source type among repositories, manuals, CAD, firmware, middleware, papers and measurements.

authority_policy.declared: A source states a design, specification or procedure; it is not physical verification.
authority_policy.observed: A visual or operator observation tied to a selected media item and timestamp.
authority_policy.simulated: Evidence generated in a model or simulator; it cannot prove physical behavior.
authority_policy.measured: Instrument-backed evidence for the exact candidate, configuration and operating envelope.
